clearAll.title: Clear All Data
clearAll.message: Are you sure you want to delete all data?
clearAll.detail:
This will permanently delete:
• All downloaded AI models
• Conversation history and pasted images
• Knowledge bases
• Settings and interface preferences
• Logs (they contain the text of your conversations)

This action cannot be undone.

The application will quit after deletion.

dataCleared.title: Data Cleared
dataCleared.message: All data has been deleted successfully.
dataCleared.detailPending:
A few files were still in use and could not be deleted yet. Erudi deletes them the next time it starts.

The application will now quit.
